backend.ask: Which vendor route drives this reader?
backend.help: bmg: BMG CLARIOstar/PHERAstar/Omega through Reader Control's ActiveX on the reader PC. softmax: Molecular Devices SpectraMax through SoftMax Pro's Automation API. spark: Tecan Spark through its SiLA 2 server.

host.ask: PC running SoftMax Pro (softmax) or the Spark SiLA 2 server (spark); Enter for this one
host.help: The BMG route is local COM and ignores this.

protocol_dir.ask: Folder holding the read protocols agents may run
protocol_dir.help: BMG: the Definit database folder of the Reader Control user. SoftMax: a folder of .spr protocol files. Spark: unused (methods live in SparkControl).

export_dir.ask: Folder the plate tables are exported to

port.ask: Port of the SoftMax Pro automation server (9000) or the Spark SiLA 2 server

control.ask: BMG Reader Control name (CLARIOstar, PHERAstar, Omega)

data_dir.ask: BMG data folder passed to Run

allowed_protocols.ask: Protocol names an agent may run (JSON list; empty = any)

max_read_minutes.ask: Longest read before the job is failed

feature.ask: Spark SiLA 2 feature holding the door and method commands
